ln=_b.strip().split("\n"); cs=ln[0].split(); ix={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cs)}
MAT=np.zeros((len(cs),len(cs)),np.int16)
for l in ln[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cs,p[1:]): MAT[ix[p[0]],ix[c]]=int(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([ix.get(c,ix['X']) for c in s],np.int16)
def best_ungapped(probe,seq,ret_ident=False):
    p=enc(probe); s=enc(seq); L=len(p)
    if len(s)<L: return (-999,-1,0.0)
    w=np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(s,L)
    sc=MAT[w,p[None,:]].sum(1); k=int(np.argmax(sc))
    ident=float((w[k]==p).mean())
    return int(sc[k]),k,ident

def usearch_all(q,cap=3000):
    url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    pr={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"json","fields":"accession,protein_name,gene_names,organism_name,length,sequence"}
    out=[];r=requests.get(url,params=pr,timeout=180);r.raise_for_status()
    while True:
        out.extend(r.json()["results"]); nx=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nx or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=requests.get(nx,timeout=180)
    return out
def seqof(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

H=seqof("Q8NFV4"); CG14717=seqof("Q9VGJ4"); CG2059=seqof("Q9W3R8")
NUC=(H[123:142],8); HIS=(H[277:297],9); OXY=(H[55:72],8)

GR={"Diptera":7147,"Lepidoptera":7088,"Hymenoptera":7399,"Coleoptera":7041,"Hemiptera":7524,"Nematoda":6231}
rows=[]
for g,t in GR.items():
    for e in usearch_all(f"(xref:panther-PTHR46118) AND (taxonomy_id:{t})"):
        rows.append((g,e["primaryAccession"],e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName"),
                     (e.get("genes") or [{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value"),
                     e["sequence"]["length"],e["sequence"]["value"]))
for g,q in [("Vertebrata","(xref:panther-PTHR46118) AND (taxonomy_id:7742) AND (reviewed:true)"),
            ("Fungi","(xref:panther-PTHR46118) AND (taxonomy_id:4751) AND (reviewed:true)")]:
    for e in usearch_all(q):
        rows.append((g,e["primaryAccession"],e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName"),
                     (e.get("genes") or [{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value"),
                     e["sequence"]["length"],e["sequence"]["value"]))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["group","acc","org","gene","length","seq"]).drop_duplicates("acc").reset_index(drop=True)

def site(s,probe,off):
    sc,st,_=best_ungapped(probe,s); t=st+off
    return (s[t] if 0<=t<len(s) else None),sc,s[max(0,t-4):t+5]
recs=[]
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    s=r.seq
    n,nsc,nctx=site(s,*NUC); h,hsc,hctx=site(s,*HIS); o,osc,octx=site(s,*OXY)
    d14=best_ungapped(CG14717[95:175],s)[0]; d20=best_ungapped(CG2059[102:182],s)[0]
    recs.append(dict(nuc=n,nuc_sc=nsc,nuc_ctx=nctx,his=h,his_ctx=hctx,oxy=o,oxy_ctx=octx,
                     paralog=("CG14717-like" if d14>d20 else "CG2059-like"),d14=d14,d20=d20))
m=pd.concat([df.drop(columns=["seq"]),pd.DataFrame(recs)],axis=1)
m["ok"]=(m.nuc_sc>=20)&(m.length>=230)
mo=m[m.ok].copy()

print("=== Nucleophile residue by clade (all PTHR46118) ===")
print(pd.crosstab(mo.group,mo.nuc).to_string())
dip=mo[mo.group=="Diptera"]
print("\n=== Diptera split by nearest D. melanogaster paralog ===")
print(pd.crosstab(dip.paralog,dip.nuc).to_string())
print("\nDiptera CG14717-like entries, nucleophile residue:")
print(dip[dip.paralog=="CG14717-like"][["acc","org","nuc","nuc_ctx","his","his_ctx","oxy_ctx"]].sort_values("org").to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,10))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.0,1.0,1.15],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

# Panel A: stacked bar, nucleophile residue by clade
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ct=pd.crosstab(mo.group,mo.nuc)
order=["Vertebrata","Fungi","Nematoda","Hemiptera","Coleoptera","Hymenoptera","Lepidoptera","Diptera"]
ct=ct.reindex(order).fillna(0)
frac=ct.div(ct.sum(1),axis=0)*100
cols_={"S":"#3b7dd8","G":"#d1495b","C":"#e0a458","D":"#8b5fbf","N":"#9aa0a6","K":"#9aa0a6"}
bot=np.zeros(len(ct))
for aa in ["S","C","D","G","N","K"]:
    if aa in frac:
        axA.barh(range(len(ct)),frac[aa],left=bot,color=cols_.get(aa,"#ccc"),
                 label=f"{aa}",edgecolor="white",height=0.68)
        bot+=frac[aa].values
axA.set_yticks(range(len(ct))); axA.set_yticklabels([f"{g} (n={int(ct.loc[g].sum())})" for g in ct.index],fontsize=9)
axA.set_xlabel("percent of family members",fontsize=9); axA.set_xlim(0,100)
axA.set_title("A  Residue at the nucleophile elbow (equivalent to human ABHD11 Ser132) in PANTHER family PTHR46118",
              fontsize=10,loc="left")
axA.legend(title="residue",fontsize=8,title_fontsize=8,ncol=6,loc="lower right",frameon=False)
for sp in ("top","right"): axA.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: Diptera, split by paralog
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
cd=pd.crosstab(dip.paralog,dip.nuc).reindex(["CG2059-like","CG14717-like"]).fillna(0)
fd=cd.div(cd.sum(1),axis=0)*100; bot=np.zeros(len(cd))
for aa in ["S","C","D","G","N"]:
    if aa in fd:
        axB.bar(range(len(cd)),fd[aa],bottom=bot,color=cols_.get(aa,"#ccc"),edgecolor="white",width=0.55)
        bot+=fd[aa].values
axB.set_xticks(range(len(cd))); axB.set_xticklabels([f"{i}\n(n={int(cd.loc[i].sum())})" for i in cd.index],fontsize=9)
axB.set_ylabel("percent",fontsize=9); axB.set_ylim(0,100)
axB.set_title("B  Dipteran paralogues",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right"): axB.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# Panel C: motif strings
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); axC.axis("off")
sel=[("human ABHD11","VVFLHGLFG","VVGHSMGGK","PNAGHWIHA"),
     ("yeast IMO32","IIILHGLFG","IIGHSMGGK","IDAGHWVNA"),
     ("Dmel CG2059","LLTYHGLFG","CMGHSMGGR","LDAGHLVHF"),
     ("Dmel CG14717","IVVMHDLNL","ALGHGMGGR","LDAGHCVYE")]
axC.text(0.02,0.95,"C  Active-site motifs",fontsize=10,transform=axC.transAxes)
axC.text(0.30,0.82,"oxyanion HG",fontsize=8,ha="center",transform=axC.transAxes)
axC.text(0.58,0.82,"nucleophile GxSxG",fontsize=8,ha="center",transform=axC.transAxes)
axC.text(0.87,0.82,"catalytic His",fontsize=8,ha="center",transform=axC.transAxes)
for i,(nm,a,b,c) in enumerate(sel):
    y=0.68-0.16*i
    bad = nm=="Dmel CG14717"
    axC.text(0.02,y,nm,fontsize=9,fontweight="bold" if bad else "normal",
             color="#d1495b" if bad else "#222",transform=axC.transAxes)
    for x,txt,hl in [(0.30,a,4),(0.58,b,4),(0.87,c,4)]:
        for k,ch in enumerate(txt):
            col="#d1495b" if (bad and k==hl and ch not in "SH") else ("#3b7dd8" if k==hl else "#555")
            axC.text(x-0.055+0.014*k,y,ch,fontsize=9.5,family="monospace",
                     fontweight="bold" if k==hl else "normal",color=col,transform=axC.transAxes)

# Panel D: structural distances
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
prot=["human\nABHD11","yeast\nIMO32","Dmel\nCG2059","Dmel\nCG14717"]
nucd=[3.19,2.95,2.98,4.23]; acidd=[2.72,2.87,2.68,2.72]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.36
axD.bar(x-w/2,nucd,w,color=["#3b7dd8"]*3+["#d1495b"],label="nucleophile OG (CA for Gly) → His NE2")
axD.bar(x+w/2,acidd,w,color="#9aa0a6",label="acid carboxylate → His ND1")

axD.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False,loc="upper left")

for sp in ("top","right"): axD.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
axD.text(3,4.35,"no OH\n(Gly120)",ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#d1495b")

# Panel E: superposition distances
axE=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
lab=["catalytic His\nNE2","catalytic Asp\nCG","oxyanion-loop\nbackbone N","nucleophile\nside-chain O"]
val=[0.51,0.32,0.37,2.65]
bars=axE.barh(range(4),val,color=["#3b7dd8","#3b7dd8","#3b7dd8","#d1495b"],height=0.6)
axE.set_yticks(range(4)); axE.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8.5); axE.invert_yaxis()
axE.set_xlabel("displacement after superposition (Å)",fontsize=9)
axE.set_title("E  CG14717 vs human ABHD11 (199 CA, RMSD 1.10 Å)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for i,v in enumerate(val): axE.text(v+0.06,i,f"{v:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=8)

fig.suptitle("CG14717 is a catalytically dead ABHD11-family protein: the nucleophile serine is lost across Drosophilidae",
